2. The facts relevant for the purpose of disposal of the Rule, in short, are, that the mother of the detenu namely, Mst Taslima Begum as informant lodged a first information report on 14-7-2000 against the accused Uttam Debanath and others on the allegation that her daughter Nazma Akhter, aged 14 years, developed love affair with the accused Uttam Debanath, that on 16-1-2000 Uttam Debanath with the help of other accused persons abducted Nazma Akhter and kept her confined in different places and committed rape on her against her will. On the basis of the said ejahar the case was started and the police took up investigation of the case and during investigation the police recovered the alleged victim Nazma Akhter and produced her before the Magistrate and the learned Magistrate sent the alleged victim Nazma Akhter to the safe custody by the order dated 15-7-2000 and since then this victim was in safe custody within Jhalakati District Jail till 8-1-2003 and from 9-1-2003 this victim is being detained in "Nirapad Abason Kendra" under Shamaj Sheba Adhidaptar, Barisal. The police after completion of investigation of the case submitted charge sheet against accused. Uttam Debanath and others and the case was ready for trial and the Tribunal also framed charge against the accused persons. At that stage, another accused Giasuddin filed a criminal miscellaneous case under section 561 A of the Code of Criminal Procedure before the Court challenging the order of framing charge and obtained Rule and also order staying all further proceedings of the case which is still existing. On behalf of petitioner Nazma Akhter petitions were moved before the Tribunal for her release but the Tribunal could not consider those petitions for the reason of stay order of the Court as aforesaid. 

 7. We have considered the submissions of the learned Advocate of both the sides and gone through the relevant papers on record. It appears that admittedly, the victim Nazma Akhter has attained the age of majority and her present age is about 20 years. The victim Nazma Akhter is not an accused of the case. But in spite of that she is being detained in safe custody for the last six years. The detention of petitioner Nazma Akhter in safe custody against her will is improper and illegal.
